role: Unified spreading activation system that primes semantic concepts before controlled traversal using four-layer neurologically-motivated design
detail: Implements automatic (Route 1: BFS activation propagation with hop decay 0.60, initial boost 0.20, max depth 2→3 developmental) and controlled (Route 2: parameterized traversal using activation map) semantic access routes. Layer 1 (Propagation Physics): BFS from source with confidence floor 0.3, attenuation per hop. Layer 2 (Accumulation Strategy): MAX strategy for overlapping boosts within TTL (30s default), prevents additive feedback. Layer 3 (Post-Traversal Inhibition): -0.05 modifier on non-traversed activated nodes, suppresses irrelevant neighbors. Layer 4 (Developmental Budget Scaling): activation budget scales with graph maturity as min(30, 10 + 5.0 * ln(edge_count+1)), main domain=10-30 slots, cross-domain=5 slots. All parameters stored in meta:spreading_activation_params EvolutionRule node (guardian-tunable). Session monitoring tracks spread_ratio p50/p95 (target 0.05-0.30) and can trigger depth advancement from 2→3 after 50+ queries with p95 ≤0.35. CANON-compliant: activation derived not pre-populated (A.1), bounded propagation (A.10), ephemeral in-memory only (A.11), cross-domain budget enforces domain boundaries (A.20).
gotchas: Cypher neighbor query limits to 50 neighbors per node (hub-node explosion prevention). Budget-based cutoff in SessionActivationMap handles overflow at larger scale. ActivationEntry and related dataclasses are frozen/immutable (new entries created on updates). _prune_expired() called on every get_activation_map() call (lazy TTL cleanup). P95/P50 percentile calculation uses int(n*0.50)-1 indexing (potential off-by-one edge case for small sample sizes). Bidirectional activation spread follows both incoming and outgoing edges (directional relationships but bidirectional activation per Collins & Loftus 1975). Depth advancement from 2→3 is one-way (once ADVANCED, never reverts). MIN_CONFIDENCE_FLOOR imported from semantic_query module (0.3 hardcoded in docstring but actual value comes from semantic_query)
